user.title: Family Tasks
user.description: Adds a points ledger for the Family Task Card. Nothing to set up: people appear with their first booking.

not_loaded.message: Family Tasks is not set up yet.

award.name: Award points
award.description: Books points for a checked-off task. A key that was already booked is ignored, so several devices can report the same task.

key.name: Key
key.description: Unique key of this task completion.

person.name: Person
person.description: Who did it (person entity or name).

revoke.name: Revoke points
revoke.description: Takes the points of an awarded task back, e.g. when it was unchecked.

key.name: Key
key.description: Key the task was awarded with.

redeem.name: Redeem points
redeem.description: Spends points on a reward. Fails when the person has too few points.

adjust.name: Adjust points
adjust.description: Gives a bonus (positive) or a deduction (negative).
